data.name: Musnid
data.gender_notes: Musnid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who is bound to knowledge
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 's-n-d' meaning 'to bind'. Musnid refers to someone who is bound to knowledge and wisdom, a scholar or a sage. In the Islamic context, it is a title of respect and honor for those who dedicate their lives to the pursuit of knowledge, especially in the study of the Quran and Hadith. The name Musnid carries the meaning “One who is bound to knowledge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Musnid usually hope their child will grow to embody one who is bound to knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies a deep understanding and connection to the divine.
data.etymology: Musnid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who is bound to knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Musnid total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_english.name: Musnid
in_english.meaning: Musnid is an Arabic name meaning 'a person who has memorized or compiled a lot of hadith or knowledge'
in_english.long_meaning: Musnid is an Arabic name meaning 'a person who has memorized or compiled a lot of hadith or knowledge', derived from the Arabic root 's-n-d' meaning 'to collect or gather', and often used to describe a person who has a strong memory and has spent their life collecting and compiling hadith and knowledge. In Islamic tradition, Musnid is considered a highly respected title for scholars and individuals who have dedicated their lives to collecting and compiling hadith and knowledge. The name Musnid is often associated with qualities such as intelligence, memory, and dedication to learning. In modern times, the name Musnid is still used in many Muslim cultures to describe a person who is highly knowledgeable and has a strong memory.
